use_when: Use type web at the top of every page of the guest website, with the current section as the first, darker link.
Use type app at the top of each app screen below the status bar: back on the left, the screen name in the centre, one text action on the right when the screen has one, such as "Save" or "Mark read".
Use type backoffice above the content of each back office page, next to the Sidebar, with the page name and search.

dont_use_when.when: More than once on a page, or inside a card or a modal.
To hold page actions such as "Export" or "Add rate": put them in the page content, under the title.
With more than three nav links on web: move the rest into the Help page or the footer.

variant_intent.web: Guest website: Logo, three nav links (Link 1 is the current page, darker), a Button and an Avatar.
variant_intent.app: App screen: back chevron, centred Title, one text Action on the right.
variant_intent.backoffice: Back office page, beside the Sidebar: Page title, a Search field and an Avatar.

a11y.fact: The root is a native <header> element.
The web nav links sit in a <nav> labelled "Main", and the current page link carries aria-current="page".
The app back control is a native <button> named "Back" via aria-label; its chevron is aria-hidden.
The app title and backoffice page title are <h1> elements.
The app action is a native <button> with its visible text as its name.
Back and action show a focus-visible outline using the focus border token.
